The '''Gree device''' was a device built from the blueprints of the ancient [[Gree technology]], the purpose of which was to launch the legendary [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[Hypergate]]s. The device, made in the form of a metal ball, used [[Dark matter/Legends|dark matter]], and therefore, in theory, could cause a devastating catastrophe.<ref name="Into the Void" />

In [[25,793 BBY]], the [[Stargazers|Stargazer cult]], ordered this device from [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] at an [[Pan Deep|underground laboratory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] in order to use the technology to activate a hypergate on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] to escape the [[Tython system/Legends|star system]]. After receiving the device, the Stargazers traveled to [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]] to acquire the rare element [[marionium]] which they used to charge the device with dark matter. However, the leader of the Stargazers, [[Dalien Brock]], was not destined to put his plan into action&mdash;he was killed moments before he could activate the device. The device was then taken to the Temple of Science of the [[Je'daii Order]], [[Anil Kesh]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
